scope: Actual engine with existing gravity; controlled DOM. Motion values are simulation units, not Capcom motion capture or new art.

checks.name: The original R11 paid focus command had no displacement; the exact old definition reproduces it
Only two mechanical commands change; no borrowed anatomy, sprite or attack is created
Both maneuvers commit their existing cost once, before any movement
Left and right flight trajectories are symmetric and bounded in continuous increments
The previous instantaneous blink is absent; the retreat moves through its active ticks
No energy means no takeoff, no invisible focus, no health or damage side effect
No midair re-trigger or unlimited flight chain is admitted
Corners restrict the real path instead of teleporting through the arena bounds
A crossing opponent does not reverse the committed maneuver halfway through its attack
Damage before activation interrupts departure without refunding its committed cost
The insect remains hittable in flight and a hit cancels the maneuver, not gravity
A low hitbox misses only when the actual body is above it, without an invulnerability flag
Repeated maneuvers cannot heal, poison, deal damage or summon an extra entity
A fresh round/reset never inherits a hovering actor or a focus buff
Seeded CPU choices can use the utility and preserve full deterministic replay states
Archived experimental replay validates flight coordinates, landing and RNG exactly
Both laboratories expose measured motion after takeoff, pause and reset without writes
Main Versus selects the correct incarnation and runs its utility through the real input path
The 114 other profiles, all Dossiers, core simulation and auxiliary content remain unchanged
